digest.component_or_area: rebar plan vocabulary and criteria detection
propositions: Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria headings carry identical semantic load across all live criteria gates and evaluation specs, with no carve-out or altitude-specific treatment, making the split vestigial.

Criteria under ## Success Criteria are written as plain bullets instead of checkboxes, preventing them from being counted by _count_ac_items, tagged with [operator-attested], or individually checkable, creating a tightening gate when collapsed to ## Acceptance Criteria.

The vocabulary split must be collapsed across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing index, author guides, generated documentation, eval specs, and 106 store tickets carrying the old heading, while preserving excluded vocabulary in plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics), plan_review_verifier.md (dod_uncertifiable), plan_review_verifier_agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), verify_models.py (dod_uncertifiable field), and O-RAN-SC occurrences.
ADR 0053 grandfathering in the regver registry-stamp mechanism makes the costly vocabulary rename now affordable after regver invalidation at ticket 1f32 reset 632 outstanding attestations.

The migration must use expand-contract sequencing: detectors accept both headings first, vocabulary and data consolidate under unified heading, then alias removal occurs, ensuring no window where tickets become un-reviewable.
